name: remix-db-migrations-deno
description: Run @remix-run/data-table migrations from Deno: remix.json db config, timestamped up.sql/down.sql directories, deno task wiring, the Deno-specific traps (unversioned npm:remix is Remix v2, node:sqlite works but pg/mysql2 must be added), and — for Turso/libSQL, which remix db cannot drive — the CLI shipped by @kuboon/remix-data-table-sqlite-turso.
